outcome: The implementer stops being the only unobservable role: google-native dispatches stream, their deltas render live exactly as deepseek and qwen deliberation already does, and thought summaries can be requested - so a forty-minute gemini build shows its work while it happens instead of freezing the log until completion, and the smart-observer doctrine gets its oversight input for the role that writes the code.

exclude: durable observation of worker activity (S8's mechanism; the stream stays presentation-only by the renderer's own doctrine)

acceptance.text: The google-native adapter requests streamGenerateContent as an operator-configurable streaming mode and feeds arriving deltas to the existing live stream renderer, while terminal validation runs the identical non-streaming accept path over the terminal response object - the same invariant the responses dialect already keeps (internal/driver/stream.go:190 readStreamedResponse returns only the terminal object). Anchors: the hardcoded generateContent suffix at internal/driver/gemini.go:256-257, providerRequest built with no Stream at gemini.go:259-261, and HTTPProfileConfig carrying no streaming knob at all (internal/driver/http.go:43) - streaming is a responses-dialect capability only today (internal/driver/openai.go:90,317-327). Pinned by adapter tests over recorded SSE fixtures.

Pacing counts streamed requests identically: the proactive sliding-minute input-token ledger and the reactive paced-retry path treat a streamed gemini dispatch exactly as an unstreamed one - the ledger sits above the dialect (internal/driver/provider.go:427-484: estimate from request-body bytes, record from accepted usage) but no shipping configuration has ever exercised streaming and pacing together, so this slice pins it by test rather than by construction.

Streamed and unstreamed dispatches are equivalent where it counts: identical usage receipts (including thoughtsTokenCount reaching ReasoningTokens, gemini.go:457-463), identical handoff validation, identical error classification - pinned by a parity test over the same fixture conversation both ways.

Thought summaries are requestable: an operator knob asks Google for thought content (include_thoughts vocabulary - requested nowhere in the tree today; only the thinkingLevel knob exists, gemini.go:66-72,155-160), and when enabled the summaries render live through the renderer's existing reasoning channel; the knob's absence changes nothing. Pinned by request-shape and render tests.

constraints: Evidence basis (sworn#225): a ~40-minute gemini implementation dispatch produced zero observable content anywhere until completion; the operator could not distinguish productive work from a hang beyond lease heartbeats, and the S3 five-attempt design churn was caught from captain verdicts only. The ratified smart-observer doctrine treats streamed worker reasoning as an oversight input.

The stream renderer stays presentation-only (internal/driver/stream.go:20-22: nothing feeds validation, rendering failures are ignored); durable observation is S8's seam, and this slice must not journal stream content.
The streaming knob is driver configuration: enabling it for a run is a config-digest change at the operator's hand, and the unstreamed path remains fully supported and certified.
The existing stream byte bound (MaxStreamBytes, stream.go:16) and the transport's redirect and size postures apply to the streamed path unchanged.
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.
